effective_item_repairs.effective_content: Gamma_t=(dOmega/dt)/C_t is the PAGE_00 Reachability Expansion Ratio definition. Regime interpretations are moved to R15:ASSERT:GAMMA_P00.
PAGE_4 definition only: Omega(S_t) is the set of future environment states reachable from S_t. The Omega+/Omega- partition remains in R15:FORMAL:P4_POSSIBILITY.

PAGE_4 formal state/equation family only: S_t, state evolution, observation, representation, prediction, action-selection and environment-transition equations. Diagrammatic information flow is moved to R15:ARCH:P4_FLOW.

PAGE_5 conceptual synthesis claims only: intelligence improves its loop, capability expands opportunity/risk, safety is interpreted through adaptation keeping pace with influence, and AIT studies modeling/transforming/creating reality with preserved feedback. Final-goal hypothesis is moved to R15:HYP:P5_FINAL_GOAL.

added_items.content: PAGE_00 interprets Gamma<1 as within correction envelope, Gamma approximately 1 as near stability boundary, and Gamma>1 as reachability growth outpacing correction.
PAGE_4 diagrammatic information flow: Environment -> Observation -> Representation -> Model/Search -> Action -> Environment.
PAGE_5 final goal is maximum adaptive capability with preserved correction, not maximum intelligence.
